catalog: dr_assets__datacube_sessions.csv from the exact pinned Git commit
primary_stratum: session_type=brainwide AND is_behavior_pass=true; naive/templeton remain separately reported, never pooled to meet the primary denominator
same_mouse_policy: One same-session same-probe primary population per canonical subject_id; do not count repeated sessions/probes as animals
future_window: [stim_start_time,stim_start_time+0.5) with causal event/lick/running covariates; not premovement prediction
instruction_trials: Exclude first5trials of every source block using original scheduled block position, regardless of later lick/reward. Do not select on actual current-trial reward/choice or label an outcome-inferred engagement state causal.
opto_policy: Exclude explicit planned opto/perturbation trials or blocks according to their recorded design flags; no behavioral-outcome-driven removal
remaining_minima: Single-probe10provider-good medial composite units;2qualifying runs/context,>=15valid trials/run;>=60trials/context in each chronological whole-block half. No thresholds changed after IBLfailure.
metadata_tables: units.parquet in consolidated metadata directory ONLY
forbidden: NWB, per-session full units tables, spikes, histograms, waveforms, amplitudes, neural count arrays, SDK automatic fallback
access_mode: Explicit anonymous HTTPS metadata HEAD/ranges; never invoke dr_datacube SDK because its fallback may read neural NWB
schema_before_columns: Save parquet footer schemas/row-group metadata before whitelisting identity/anatomy/quality/context/event columns; no spike-valued column decoded
license_status: Must verify source data license separately; code license is not automatically a data license. Missing dr LICENSE endpoint404 is preserved, not inferred permission.
